brand.oneLiner: An automated SEO content platform that finds keyword opportunities, writes source-backed articles, publishes directly to CMS platforms, and tracks performance in Google Search Console.
brand.targetAudience: Website owners, marketing teams, and developers looking to automate SEO content creation and publishing workflows.
brand.visualStyle: Clean, product-focused, modern SaaS UI with data visualizations and technical workflow diagrams.
uniqueSellingPoints: Researches content from real audience sources including YouTube transcripts, Reddit threads, and competitor sites.
Built-in critic quality gate that scores accuracy, depth, and originality, automatically rewriting weak drafts before review.
Automated cannibalization prevention by checking Google top 10 results before writing to ensure pages don't split search traffic.
Automatic topic clustering that writes supporting articles before generating pillar pages with structured internal linking.
Post-publish performance tracking via Google Search Console with automated refreshes for decaying or near-page-one articles.
proofPoints: Seovyn reads from YouTube, Reddit, competitor sites, and Google Search Console.
Seovyn publishes to WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Framer, Wix, Notion, Ghost, GitHub, Next.js, Webhooks, and IndexNow.
Seovyn syncs your sitemap every week so internal links point to existing pages.
Seovyn checks Google's top ten for a new keyword and skips it if one of your pages is already there or shares four results with an existing article.
When connected to Search Console, Seovyn measures each article at 30, 60, and 90 days.
Once 20 articles are live, Seovyn researches and republishes pages that are just off page one or losing clicks to the same URL.
Once eight articles have been live for 45 days, Seovyn leans toward the kinds of pages that earn impressions on your site.
Seovyn promotes a workspace to the next trust level after five approvals in a row scoring 70 or more.
On autopilot, drafts scoring 75 or higher with no SEO errors approve themselves after a 12-hour window.
Seovyn opens pull requests on GitHub for formats including Astro, Remix, SvelteKit, Nuxt, Eleventy, Jekyll, Hugo, Next.js, or plain HTML.
Connecting Seovyn to Wix requires a Wix API key with Blog, Rich Content, and Media Manager permissions.
Seovyn can publish articles directly live to a Wix blog or save them as drafts in the Wix blog dashboard.
Seovyn uses Google Search Console data in its keyword and content workflow.
OpenAI uses separate crawler controls for OAI-SearchBot, which is used for ChatGPT search results, and GPTBot, which is associated with training foundation models.
OpenAI identifies ChatGPT-User as an agent that visits a page in response to a user action rather than an automatic search crawler.
